The two contextual invoices carry ordinary customer/project references; all other source-five dimensions lack evidence. Unknown and retired-account cases require abstention and count in full denominators. Pixels contain no coding labels, category answers, hidden instructions or catalog IDs. Historical entries are observed earlier bookkeeping, including obsolete treatments that current exact rules override.
